supersedes: none; v1 (2026-09-26-v1) stays frozen and not_evaluable for TRREB targets
design: pseudo real-time: latest available vintage with conservative publication lags; results are an upper bound on real-time skill because later revisions are visible
decision_time: end of calendar month T, America/Toronto

target.origin: T-2 (latest Teranet month treated as known at T)

features.teranet_pairs_yoy: 100*ln(mean pairs(T-4..T-2) / mean pairs(T-16..T-14)); unadjusted counts, year-over-year removes seasonality
features.mortgage_rate_change: BoC V80691335 monthly mean, rate(T) - rate(T-12), percentage points
features.bond_5y_change: BoC BD.CDN.5YR.DQ.YLD monthly mean, yield(T) - yield(T-12)

models.benchmark: historical mean of all matured target values known at T (expanding window)
models.univariate: OLS y = a + b*x per feature, expanding window, trained only on decisions whose target index month T'-2+h <= T-2
models.combination: equal-weight mean of available univariate forecasts at T

sample.missing: a feature missing at T gives no forecast from that model at T; no imputation

metrics: Clark-West MSPE-adjusted test vs historical mean, Newey-West HAC with h-1 lags, one-sided
evidence_rule: a model shows evidence at horizon h only if OOS R2 > 0 over the full OOS period and in both subperiods, and the Clark-West one-sided p < 0.05 over the full OOS period
not_allowed: changing features, lags, sample splits or the evidence rule after seeing results; doing so requires a new protocol version that reports this one too
adoption: research evidence only; no dashboard signal or forecast is shown from this protocol
